G4504G.name: Rufus
G4504G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4504G.brief: Son of Simon of Cyrene, who carried Jesus' cross
G4504G.short: Rufus was the son of Simon of Cyrene, who was compelled to carry Jesus' cross on the way to His crucifixion.

G4504H.name: Rufus
G4504H.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4504H.brief: Believer in Rome, son of Paul's "mother"
G4504H.short: Rufus was a believer in Rome, chosen in the Lord, whose mother had also been a mother figure to Paul.

G4539.name: Salome
G4539.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G4539.brief: Witness of Jesus' crucifixion and resurrection
G4539.short: Salome was one of the women who witnessed Jesus' crucifixion and resurrection. She was perhaps the wife of Zebedee.

G4551.name: Sapphira
G4551.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G4551.brief: Wife of Ananias, lied to the apostles, died
G4551.short: Sapphira, along with her husband Ananias, lied to the apostles about the proceeds from a property sale and died as a result.

G4580.name: Secundus
G4580.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4580.short: Secundus was a Thessalonian believer who accompanied Paul on his journey.

G4584.name: Semein
G4584.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G4584.short: Semein is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ, as recorded in Luke's Gospel.

G4588.name: Sergius Paulus
G4588.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4588.brief: Proconsul of Cyprus, converted under Paul's ministry
G4588.short: Sergius Paulus, the proconsul of Cyprus, was an intelligent man who sought to hear the word of God and believed after witnessing Paul's confrontation with Elymas the sorcerer.

G4528G.name: Shealtiel
G4528G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G4528G.brief: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
G4528G.short: Shealtiel is mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus as an ancestor in the line of David.

G4524.name: Zadok
G4524.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G4524.short: Zadok is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in the genealogy recorded by Matthew.

G4514.name: Rome
G4514.brief: Capital city of the Roman Empire
G4514.short: Rome was the capital of the Roman Empire, where Paul was imprisoned and wrote several epistles (<ref="Act.28.16; Rom. 1:7">Act.28.16; Rom. 1:7</ref>).

G4529.name: Salamis
G4529.brief: City on Cyprus visited by Paul and Barnabas
G4529.short: Salamis was a city on the island of Cyprus where Paul and Barnabas preached the gospel in the Jewish synagogues (<ref="Act.13.5">Act.13.5</ref>).

G4530.name: Salim
G4530.brief: Place near Aenon where John the Baptist baptized
G4530.short: Salim was a place near Aenon where John the Baptist was baptizing, because there was plenty of water there (<ref="Jhn.3.23">Jhn.3.23</ref>).

G4534.name: Salmone
G4534.brief: Promontory on the island of Crete
G4534.short: Salmone was a promontory on the island of Crete that Paul's ship passed on his voyage to Rome (<ref="Act.27.7">Act.27.7</ref>).

G4544.name: Samos
G4544.brief: Island visited by Paul during his travels
G4544.short: Samos is an island in the Aegean Sea where Paul stopped during his third missionary journey (<ref="Act.20.15">Act.20.15</ref>).

G4543.name: Samothrace
G4543.brief: Island visited by Paul during his second missionary journey
G4543.short: Samothrace is an island in the Aegean Sea where Paul and his companions landed during his second missionary journey (<ref="Act.16.11">Act.16.11</ref>).

G4581.name: Seleucia
G4581.brief: Port city from which Paul and Barnabas sailed
G4581.short: Seleucia was the port city from which Paul and Barnabas sailed to Cyprus on their first missionary journey (<ref="Act.13.4">Act.13.4</ref>).

G4523.name: Sadducee
G4523.brief: A Jewish sect that denied the resurrection and spirits
G4523.short: The Sadducees were a Jewish sect that denied the resurrection, angels, and spirits, and often clashed with Jesus and the early church (<ref="Matthew 22:23; Act.23.6-8">Matthew 22:23; Act.23.6-8</ref>).
